description.zh:
返回值语言，取值： 
          
- **zh-CN**：中文。

- **en-US**（默认值）：英文。
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh-CN**: Chinese.

- **en-US** (default): English.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique token for each request. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

description.zh:
域名实例配置ID，相同接入域名、相同的GTM实例可以同时配置A和AAAA记录，此情况下相同的GTM实例会出现2个域名实例配置，ConfigId可以唯一标识本次需要修改的域名实例配置。

调用[ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~2797349~~) 接口可查询域名实例对应的 ConfigId 值。
description.en:
The ID of the instance configuration. A GTM instance can have multiple configurations if you add both an A record and an AAAA record for the same domain name. The ConfigId uniquely identifies the configuration that you want to update.

For more information, see [ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs](~~2797349~~).

description.zh: 需要修改备注信息的全局流量管理GTM3.0实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance for which you want to update the remarks.

description.zh: 备注，传入参数即为更新后的目标备注内容。
description.en: The new remarks for the configuration.
